failure_modes.cause: BPR set to 0.0 bar instead of required 1.12 bar
failure_modes.mitigation: Adjust BPR to at least 1.12 bar to maintain system pressure

failure_modes.cause: Vapour pressure of solvent exceeds pump inlet pressure at T = 60°C
failure_modes.mitigation: Pressurise feed reservoir to 0.5 bar above vapour pressure

failure_modes.cause: Prolonged exposure of PFA to industrial batch solvent at elevated temperature
failure_modes.mitigation: Regularly inspect and replace PFA tubing as needed

single_points_of_failure: BPR valve — blockage stops all flow
validation_experiments: Run blank solvent at Q=0.5 mL/min for 60 min; monitor pressure for drift > 5%
Test BPR adjustment to 1.12 bar and monitor system stability over 2 hours
Conduct material compatibility test for PFA with solvent at 60°C for 24 hours
